description: List git-conflicted memory files, or attempt a field-level 3-way merge of one. Semantic conflicts are reported, never auto-resolved. Run it when a git pull or merge leaves memory files conflicted; the merged file is written in place (undo with git if the merge is wrong). For PR review state rather than file conflicts, use memory_pr_status. (MCP server and the `open-memex resolve` CLI; the opencode native plugin does not expose this tool.)

target.description: Memory id or file path to resolve. Omit to list conflicts.

name: memory_resolve
